# Object cut-out with SAM 2.1

SAM 2.1 separates a moving Magnifito mug from a busy confetti background from four click points on the first frame (three on the body, one on the handle), handle hole included, locally on Apple Silicon. A wipe compares the original with the cut-out on a new Magnifito background, then holds a split: the left half shows the SAM mask tracking the mug, the right half the composite. The footage is synthetic and silent.

- Type: Object cut-out
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `separate`
- Output: 1280x720, 8 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/09-object-cutout.mp4`](../videos/09-object-cutout.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Here is an 8-second product shot of our Magnifito mug over a busy confetti background (work/source.mp4). Cut the mug out with mgvideo separate (four click points on the mug on frame 0, one of them on the handle) and put it on a new Magnifito-branded background, a cream plate in our brand browns with our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) large behind the mug and a soft drop shadow, 16:9. Then make a before/after: wipe from the original to the new version, and finish on a centre split with the green SAM mask preview on the left and the composite on the right, labelled, so people can see how well the mask tracks the mug and its handle.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 09-object-cutout
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/09-object-cutout/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
node make-footage.mjs
mgvideo separate work/source.mp4 --point 330,330 --point 330,470 --point 300,400 --point 487,390 --out work/sep
ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -i work/sep/preview.mp4 -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i work/brand-bg.png -i work/sep/cutout.mov -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i work/label-original.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i work/label-mask.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i work/label-after.png -filter_complex "[3:v]split[c1][c2];[c2]colorchannelmixer=rr=0:gg=0:bb=0:aa=0.45,gblur=sigma=12[sh];[2:v][sh]overlay=14:20[b1];[b1][c1]overlay=0:0[b2];[b2][6:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[after];[0:v][4:v]overlay=0:0[o1];[1:v][5:v]overlay=0:0[p1];[o1][p1]overlay=0:0:enable='gte(t,3.4)',format=yuv420p[before];[before][after]blend=all_expr='if(lt(X,W*if(lt(T,1),1,if(lt(T,2.2),1-(((T-1)/1.2)*((T-1)/1.2)*(3-2*((T-1)/1.2))),if(lt(T,3.4),0,if(lt(T,4.4),0.5*(((T-3.4)/1.0)*((T-3.4)/1.0)*(3-2*((T-3.4)/1.0))),0.5))))),A,B)'[w];color=c=0x573a30:s=6x720:r=30[line];[w][line]overlay=x='W*if(lt(t,1),1,if(lt(t,2.2),1-(((t-1)/1.2)*((t-1)/1.2)*(3-2*((t-1)/1.2))),if(lt(t,3.4),0,if(lt(t,4.4),0.5*(((t-3.4)/1.0)*((t-3.4)/1.0)*(3-2*((t-3.4)/1.0))),0.5))))-3':y=0:shortest=0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 8 -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p work/final.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/final.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
